claim.excerpt: Cases where only methamphetamine was detected had a higher blood methamphetamine concentration (2.68; SD, 13.7 µg/mL) than cases with multiple substances (1.62; SD, 7.59 µg/mL), but this difference was not significant (P = 0.255).

sources.title: Shedding Light on Hidden Methamphetamine Abuse: A Nation-wide 7-year Post-mortem Study in Taiwan

why_it_matters: Concentration values are often misread as thresholds; the reviewer must confirm specimen, population, statistic and that the value is reported in context only.
limitations: SD exceeds the mean — strongly skewed distribution.

reviewer_checklist: Excerpt matches the source at the stated location.
